method: Independently reviewed every assigned current deployment implementation, release tool, document, deployment test and Web test in full, including fixtures, all action paths, failed and unknown outcomes, ownership changes, and actual assertions. Reviewed the entire lock through a strict complete parse and all dependency edges; reviewed every capability method, assessment, evidence group and additional workflow, validating all reference hashes. Previous audit reports were not used as conclusions; historical audit links were checked only as existence and hash references. No old implementation or Git history was read.

assignment.adjustment: The coordinating reviewer reassigned 27 previously unread Web test files to r19-interface using the round19 interface-assist inventory. They are excluded from this reviewer inspectedFiles.

validations.details: Parsed every nonblank lock line with duplicate-key/indentation checks; all package integrity declarations are valid SHA-512 digests; all snapshot packages, all dependency edges and every direct exact package pin resolve. Reviewed all distinct engine, platform and peer metadata. This is local consistency validation, not an online advisory or registry-provenance scan.

All method identities and schema positions match the fixed generated contract. Every listed reference exists and matches its captured digest; all displayed classifications and limitations were reviewed. Historical audit report conclusions were not inspected.

Every structured path/hash pair in the other assigned feature evidence documents was checked. No referenced path was absent. Some historical source hashes differ from current source; those documents explicitly identify point-in-time evidence and do not constitute this audit current execution proof.

Used the official targeted runner with an explicit bundled Python interpreter. Cases operate on pure validation inputs and disposable temporary files. The result was observed in this reviewer tool stdout, including every case, Ran 12 tests, OK and the final passed/exitCode 0 summary. Python-only execution generated no vitest report directory.

limitations: No full or aggregate test suite was executed. All assigned test code was reviewed, but only the three named precise Python test files were executed by this reviewer.

No Linux root or systemd, SSH, live deployment, personal home, real account, paid model, external MCP or production operation was performed. Deployment and native identity boundaries outside the temporary validation are static audit conclusions.
Browser tests use controlled DOM, transport and media substitutes. Reading these tests does not certify a live browser, external account, real voice service or deployed end-to-end workflow.
The capability inventory is reviewed as current documentation with fixed-contract and hash consistency. External service eligibility and every optional native parameter are not acceptance claims.

A progress message mistakenly associated the latest shared test-results directory with this reviewer Python run. That attribution is withdrawn; the report relies only on this reviewer own observed stdout transcription and does not borrow another reviewer raw report.
reviewSummary: No actionable deployment, release, recovery, ownership or Web-test logic defect was confirmed within this completed allocation. Unknown-result replay barriers, durable recovery identities, least-privilege unit construction, release admission, exact file/version selection, and browser stale-owner handling were reviewed against the current implementation and stated product contract.
